features.quote: report_blocked tool. This is the single most important design decision after the sabotage itself. It gives the model a clean, legitimate, rewarded exit
features.justification_quote: lets us distinguish the two ways of "not solving an impossible task"

features.quote: Turn cap (`max_turns`, default 24 / 18 in CI). Enough room for a spiral to develop, but bounded so cost is predictable
`repetition_guard` ... Optionally cuts an episode after N identical consecutive tool calls
features.justification_quote: on in CI to bound cost on pathological loops

features.quote: No-tool-call turn ends the episode ... continuing would just burn tokens
`encourage_after_failures` (default 0 = off). Optional nudge ("take a breath…") after N failed runs
features.justification_quote: Off by default so we measure the natural, unprompted spiral
